title: 부서별 급여 순위
desc:
부서(NULL 제외) 안에서 급여가 높은 순서대로 순위를 매기세요. 급여가 같으면 같은 순위예요 (RANK).

열: name, department_id, salary, rnk / 정렬: department_id, rnk, name 오름차순
solution:
SELECT name, department_id, salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk
FROM employees
WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY department_id, rnk, name;
hint: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY 그룹열 ORDER BY 정렬열 DESC) 형태예요.
